f2_mapping_lock.scope_note: The inspected WP507 source is repository-component evidence from the bound PR head, not target-runtime evidence.

layers.name: SPECIFICATION
layers.shape: OpenTelemetry-compatible trace model plus AI-specific semantic conventions for spans, attributes, evaluations and privacy configuration.

layers.name: PYTHON_CORE
layers.shape: openinference-instrumentation exposes OITracer, TraceConfig, typed attribute builders, context helpers, capture helpers and optional blob-upload plumbing.

layers.name: SEMANTIC_CONVENTIONS_PACKAGE
layers.shape: separate package supplies canonical OpenInference attribute/span-kind names used by the core.

layers.name: FRAMEWORK_PROVIDER_ADAPTERS
layers.shape: many separately located integration packages instrument specific agent/model/framework ecosystems; this is a broad adapter surface rather than one compact runtime.

important_source_mechanics: OITracer wraps an OpenTelemetry Tracer via wrapt.ObjectProxy.
OITracer creates trace/span IDs with a randomness source isolated from user application random seeds when the wrapped tracer uses RandomIdGenerator.
TraceConfig masking is applied before attributes are passed to the sampler so samplers do not see values that policy says to hide.
Instrumentation suppression can produce an invalid/non-recording span path.
OITracer exposes semantic decorators/helpers for AGENT, CHAIN, RETRIEVER, RERANKER, GUARDRAIL, EVALUATOR and TOOL-like operations.
Post-hoc evaluation is represented by a new evaluator carrier linked to an immutable ended target span/trace.

mapping.reason: WP507 already binds broadcast, selection and GRID10 plan IDs, generations and SHA-256 digests plus cell/provenance/downstream evidence. OpenInference IDs are generated observability identifiers and are weaker than F2 causal identity.

AGENT/TOOL/LLM/EVALUATOR/CHAIN labels can improve trace readability but must not redefine F2 workpackage, GWT or effect semantics. F2-specific operations such as broadcast/uptake should remain explicit F2 attributes rather than being forced into misleading generic kinds.

mapping.f2_target: projection of exact F2 receipt IDs/digests into telemetry attributes
mapping.reason: A projection can carry f2.broadcast_id, generation, digest, selection identity, plan identity, cell identity and receipt digest for search/visualization while the authoritative objects remain F2-native.

mapping.f2_target: append-only observer projection for later evaluation of an immutable F2 receipt/runpackage
mapping.reason: It preserves historical execution records instead of mutating them and gives late judgments an explicit target link. The F2 target ref/hash must remain authoritative; the span link is correlation metadata.
Explicit HUMAN/LLM/CODE producer classes and stable producer identifiers fit F2 epistemic separation. LLM evaluations remain candidate judgments only.

Mask-before-sampler is a strong pattern because hidden content is not leaked to sampling logic; upstream hide switches mostly default false, so F2 should use a fail-closed allowlist or stricter defaults instead of copying defaults.

It is experimental and introduces an asynchronous external storage/effect path. Trigger-6 source archaeology grants no effect authorization and F2 does not need it for the current causal-evidence frontier.

critical_mismatches.finding: OpenInference/OpenTelemetry trace/span IDs are observer IDs and may be randomly generated; deterministic replay-stable F2 causal identity must never depend on them.

The wrapped OpenTelemetry path can be sampled or suppressed. Therefore missing telemetry cannot establish non-delivery, non-uptake or absence of a real event. Authoritative F2 evidence must exist independently of observer completeness.
Parent-child traces and span links encode correlation/structure, not matched intervention causal influence. WP507's intervention/control invariants remain required.
Many upstream hide switches default false. Direct instrumentation could record prompts, outputs, tool definitions and model parameters that F2 should not export by default.
Generic AI span kinds do not encode F2-specific BroadcastEnvelope, semantic uptake, Hyperposition frame version, EffectGate or receipt authority distinctions; those must remain explicit F2 fields.

Full runtime adoption adds OpenTelemetry SDK/API, semantic-conventions and wrapper dependencies plus potential integration packages, while the highest-value mechanisms can be represented by a thin F2-native projection contract.

proposed_f2_shape.name: F2_NONAUTHORITATIVE_OPENINFERENCE_PROJECTION/v0
proposed_f2_shape.flow: F2 authoritative receipt/runpackage -> pure projection adapter -> OpenInference/OTel-compatible span attributes/links -> optional exporter
required_invariants: F2-native causal IDs/digests remain primary and are copied as attributes, never replaced by trace/span IDs.
Observer output cannot mint UnifiedDB state, GWT uptake, causal influence, completion or effect authority.
Missing sampled/suppressed telemetry is UNKNOWN, never negative evidence about the underlying F2 event.
Post-hoc evaluator records bind target F2 ref + digest and producer class/identifier.
LLM evaluator output remains judgment telemetry, not fact.
Sensitive content uses fail-closed allowlisting/redaction before any sampler/exporter sees it.
No experimental blob uploader or external storage effect is part of the initial shape.
Projection must be rebuildable from existing admitted F2 evidence.

hypothesis.statement: A tiny one-way OpenInference-compatible projection over existing F2 receipts will improve cross-tool observability and post-hoc evaluator provenance without weakening F2 causal identity, provided the adapter exports only allowlisted metadata and never feeds canonical state/effect decisions.

counterhypothesis.statement: F2-native evidence is already sufficiently searchable and semantically explicit, so even a thin compatibility projection may add schema/version/privacy burden with little information gain.
counterhypothesis.falsifier: A next Trigger-6 EXPERIMENTAL_FALSIFIER should implement no production integration: use a deterministic local fixture that projects representative WP507 receipt/probe data into an OpenInference-compatible shape, then measure identity preservation, redaction behavior, payload overhead and whether any query/evaluation task becomes materially easier than using the native receipt alone. If not, retire the candidate at E2.
